title: Price observation
description: One sighting of a product's price at one store on one day. A 'deal' is an observation with a promo. Regular-price sightings (no promo) matter just as much: they are the reference that exposes fake discounts.

seller.description: Online: shop name inside the marketplace, e.g. 'Wardah Official Store'

price.description: Total rupiah paid for `quantity` sellable packs, after the promo, before any cashback

quantity.description: Sellable packs received for `price` (Beli 2 Gratis 1 => 3). Default 1.

claimed_normal_price.description: The store's own 'normal'/strikethrough price for ONE pack, as printed. Leave out if none shown.

label.description: Promo text as printed, e.g. 'Hemat 30%' or 'Beli 2 Gratis 1'

cashback.description: Guaranteed cashback in rupiah on the whole purchase

min_purchase.description: Minimum spend in rupiah to get the price (tebus murah)

payment_method.description: If tied to a payment method, e.g. 'GoPay'

contributor.description: Name or handle to credit; never an email or phone number
